_readme: Federal parameters of the site, each read on the official document cited in `sources` (copies in research/). State figures live in src/data/states.json and src/data/hud/<ST>.json (built from research/ by scripts/build-data.py). Never type a figure in a page: read it here through src/lib/kit.ts.

fpl._source: hhsPoverty (2026, 91 FR 1797, January 15, 2026) and frPoverty2025 (2025, 90 FR 5917, January 17, 2025). [first person, each additional person], annual dollars.

snap._source: usdaCola27 (memo of August 21, 2026, FY 2027, October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2027) and usdaCola26 (memo of August 14, 2025, FY 2026). Arrays by household size 1 to 8, then the amount per additional person.
snap._rules: 7 CFR 273.9 (income and deductions), 7 CFR 273.10(e) (benefit = maximum allotment minus 30% of net income, rounded; minimum benefit for eligible 1 and 2 person households).

medicaid._source: cmsLevels (CMS table of MAGI eligibility levels by state, as of December 1, 2023); the 5% of FPL MAGI disregard (42 CFR 435.603(d)(4)); OBBBA sections 71107, 71109, 71112, 71119 (obbba).

aca._source: irsRp2525 (applicable percentage table for 2026, Rev. Proc. 2025-25), irsPtcBasics, healthcareFpl (2025 guidelines are used for 2026 coverage), obbba sections 71301 to 71305. The 2021 to 2025 table is the statutory one in 26 U.S.C. 36B(b)(3)(A)(iii), which expired after 2025.

eitc._source: irsRp2532 (tax year 2026, section 3.06), irsEitcTables (tax year 2025: maximum credit and completed phaseout), 26 U.S.C. 32(b)(1) (credit and phaseout percentages).
eitc._rates: phase-in and phaseout percentages by number of qualifying children 0, 1, 2, 3 or more

wic._source: frWic (2026/2027 income eligibility guidelines, 91 FR 23050, April 29, 2026, effective July 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027) and cfr2467 (7 CFR 246.7: adjunctive income eligibility).

hud._source: hudIl (FY 2026 Section 8 income limits, effective May 1, 2026), hudHotma (2026 inflation-adjusted values, effective January 1, 2026), cfr24-5611 and cfr24-5628.

ssi._source: ssaSsi (2026 federal payment amounts, 2.8% COLA effective January 2026), ssaSsiResources, cfr20-4161124 and ssaSsiIncome.
